data_fields.name: fx_pool_cap
data_fields.donor_constant: none (no cap in donor; arena grows)

best_idea: Recycle fixed-size combat-feedback records (damage numbers, sparks, hit records) through a free-list pool that counts total, free and in-use items, so a leak shows as a non-zero in-use count at teardown.
decision_why: Keep the pool with the in-use count and the teardown leak report; JS has no intrusive free list (use an array), and a cap is added because the donor's arena grows without limit.
acceptance: A Vitest: after 10,000 spawn-and-despawn cycles of hit records in a scripted 3-attacker fight, the pool's total stays at its warm-up peak (64 or fewer), the in-use count returns to 0 after the fight, and a record that is never destroyed makes the test fail.
